newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares drift down, seek direction.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares drift down, seek direction.

text.p: Austrian shares closed mildly weaker in moderate trade on Thursday and traders were divided as to the direction the market was likely to take.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips ended 2.71 points or 0.23 percent lower at 1,170.16. Among its constituents 10 shares rose, eight fell and three were unchanged.
"We're a bit hemmed in at the moment," said one trader. "We're lacking direction."
Some were optimistic the trend in the market remained bullish. "It's definitely looking positive," said one dealer, predicting the index was headed for 1,250 points.
Traders said U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony later today could provide some impulse for the market.
Luxury hosiery maker Wolford was the biggest gainer, climbing 2.49 pct to 1,440 schillings.
Fibre maker Lenzing led the decliners, dropping 4.63 percent to 596 schillings.
The February ATX future lost 2.5 points to 1,176.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index shed 0.48 points or 0.11 percent to 438.16.
